goal: Order vegetarian/vegan food, ask about meat/fish ingredients, and request plant-based milk.
vocabulary_scope: ingredients to check (meat, fish, broth, eggs, dairy)
required_interactions: Asking if a dish is vegetarian or vegan
Inquiring about hidden ingredients like meat broth or lard
Requesting to remove or substitute an ingredient (e.g., no cheese)
Asking for plant-based milk for coffee
Confirming if a dessert contains eggs or milk
common_problems: Lack of vegan options in traditional menus
